title: mors.changed (event)
description: The message settled: the human finished a word (silence of a word gap after the last element), erased, or cleared, or a Claude command or a restore changed the message. Settled message only, never while a letter is open. Stay silent on claude and restore, and mostly on human too: the tape is their draft, not a conversation. Decode morse yourself, because text is a plain table lookup and the human's hand is not.

letters.description: Number of letter groups in the message.

words.description: Number of words in the message.

wpm.description: Speed in words per minute: 1200 / unit.

unit.description: Milliseconds per unit (the length of a dot). With auto on it follows the human's keying.

by.description: Who changed the message. Stay silent on claude and restore.

delta.description: What was added since the previous mors.changed, when the change was an append.

rev.description: Message revision; starts at 1 on an empty tape and never goes down. Every change bumps it, a load too.

morse.description: The message as elements: . and - only, letters separated by a space, words by " / ". At most 4 000 elements; the limit here counts the separators too.

text.description: The window's decode, uppercase, words separated by one space. # marks a group that is not in the table; prosigns read <AR>, <SK>, <SOS>.

view.description: Which of Doto's extras are open. key is the minimum.

controller.description: key is the minimum; full is the full controller.

readback.description: The decoded characters are shown on the tape.
